critique: The cyan/teal bubbles on black and the upward-changing particle arrangement are strongly aligned with the Rising Bubbles direction. Compared with the prior pass, the field is less uniformly crowded and individual particles are easier to distinguish. However, the bubbles remain too soft, oversized, and heavily overlapping—especially in the lower-center and left edge at t4—so they read more like glowing bokeh blobs than clean, legible bubble discs. A slightly lower emission rate, smaller maximum size, and much firmer edges would make the stream feel more composed and thumbnail-like.

suggestions.why: Reduce simultaneous visible particles and overlapping clusters so the composition reads as a deliberate rising stream rather than a crowded field.
Pull back the dominant oversized discs that currently occupy large portions of the frame and obscure neighboring bubbles.
Sharpen the bubble silhouettes substantially; the present 25-pixel feather creates diffuse glow/bokeh rather than readable circular bubble forms.
